result.topic_en: Euler remarks that the vibration solutions found so far cover only particular curve species (distinguished by how many times they cross the axis) rather than a general solution, and begins investigating the forces needed to hold the lamina fixed in the wall, via the sum and moment of the elementary forces.

items.english: Yet this whole solution is highly particular, since it is restricted only to certain species of curves, and we are still very far from a general solution such as could be given for strings.

items.quote:

laminam in muro continendam requiruntur, inueſti-
gemus.
items.english: It remains therefore for us to investigate the forces mentioned above which are required to hold the lamina in the wall.
